summary: Phase 4.5 first piece (commit ca184b9). The operator confirmed v1 is done — the email plumbing is complete — and asked to continue with the next phase. HomeScreen was restructured from a single scrolling surface into a top-level segmented-control tab bar with three tabs: Journal (the diary — the existing JournalTabs with its life-layer category sub-tabs), Identity (the IdentityCard plus the signed identity attestation), and Captured (an honest, explicit coming-soon placeholder for the capture bridge that is not yet built). There is deliberately no People tab — the operator's People vision is the Mycelium peer network, Layer 3, spec-blocked by D-04. The backup-health banner stays above the tab bar so a warning is never hidden behind a tab; the journal composer and the Sign-someone-else / New-entry buttons render only on the Journal tab. Tabs are a segmented control under the header rather than a bottom bar, which would have collided with the floating New-entry button.

why.text: Operator 2026-05-22: 'Awesome let's continue building the next phase. Email is complete v1 done.' Phase 4.5 (tabbed home) was decided in D-08 and the tab structure was grounded against the real HomeScreen.tsx and operator-blessed in prior turns. The code was re-read fresh before editing, per the grounding-gate hook now in force.

outcome.tests_passing: 19/19 across 5 test files (persona-contract, features-registry, library-seam, file-size, keys-never-leave). tapit-attest unchanged 82/78/0/4.
outcome.notes: [P-001] HomeScreen restructured into Journal / Identity / Captured tabs (commit ca184b9). [P-002] Captured is an honest coming-soon placeholder; no People tab. [P-003] all four gates green; HomeScreen ~155 lines, under the file-size warn tier. Build-verified, NOT Carpenter-pixel-verified — operator verifies on the live deploy. [FEEDBACK->Foreman]: no notes — the tab structure was grounded and blessed before the cut, a clean single pass.

uncertainty: A UI change verified only by gates that cannot see pixels. The tab interaction, the segmented-control styling, and the Captured placeholder all read well in the markup but want the operator's eyes on a phone. Edge case left intentionally simple: switching away from the Journal tab while the composer is open keeps the composer state — it simply is not rendered until the Journal tab is active again.
next: Operator verifies the tabbed home on the live deploy. Next build is Capture Bridge Tier 1 — the Web Share Target — which the Captured tab is the home for. Then MYCELIUM_NETWORK_SPEC.md so the People tab can be designed properly.
